== Strategy ==

Just a sec..

Alright first turn pull east platform and get someone to it wtih jabbas prize or wait at tower till you get 2-3 characters as escort for the prize.

second turn pull db 94

third turn audience chamber etc.

once this happens either pull jabba with audience chamber or i sometimes pull arica and keep rebels from controlling audience or beating down 1 person there.

You shouldnt have too much problem with ground just use all wrapped up and fett and bossk etc to do bountys to the tower. Tehrmal detonators help in retrieval and also

can kill the qui-gon obiwan combo easily with a suicide bounty hunter.

i included tallon roll and lateral damage and emergency deployment(V) to help defend agianst dedicated alliance air decks.

combo-baron fel in saber 1, colonel jendon in onyx 1 and yorr in onyx 2 for 18 pwer 3 destiny and if ya want use a tallon roll or cannons to really wreak havoc in space.

You may also be thinking why i have combat response in this deck but its because to also help with air.

To finish off the opponent i sometimes (usually) carbon freeze which is each with ugnaugts and if you controll the chamber.

well thats it and if you have any suggestions on my hybrid carbon frezing/space deck please post them for me plz.

thanks alot.
